items.source: This connection factory implements InitializingBean and SmartLifecycle for flexible lifecycle control. It must be initialized and started before you can obtain a connection. Initialization starts this bean early by default. You can Lifecycle.stop() and restart this connection factory if needed. Disabling early startup leaves lifecycle management to the container refresh if auto-startup is enabled.
items.translation: 该连接工厂实现了InitializingBean和SmartLifecycle接口，以支持灵活的生命周期控制。在获取连接之前，必须初始化并启动该工厂。初始化默认会提前启动此 Bean（除非禁用早期启动）。如有需要，您可以调用Lifecycle.stop()和restart来停止或重启该连接工厂。如果启用了自动启动，则禁用早期启动会将生命周期管理交由容器刷新处理。

items.source: This factory creates a new LettuceConnection on each call to getConnection(). While multiple LettuceConnections share a single thread-safe native connection by default, LettuceConnection and its clustered variant are not Thread-safe and instances should not be shared across threads.
items.translation: 该工厂在每次调用 getConnection() 时都会创建一个新的 LettuceConnection。虽然多个 LettuceConnection 默认情况下共享单个线程安全的原生连接，但 LettuceConnection 及其集群变体并非线程安全，因此实例不应在多个线程之间共享。

items.source: The shared native connection is never closed by LettuceConnection, therefore it is not validated by default on getConnection(). Use setValidateConnection(boolean) to change this behavior if necessary. If shareNativeConnection is true, a shared connection will be used for regular operations and a LettuceConnectionProvider will be used to select a connection for blocking and tx operations only, which should not share a connection. If native connection sharing is disabled, new (or pooled) connections will be used for all operations.
items.translation: 共享的原生连接永远不会由 LettuceConnection 关闭，因此默认情况下不会在 getConnection() 上进行验证。如有必要，请使用 setValidateConnection(boolean) 来更改此行为。如果 shareNativeConnection 为 true，则常规操作将使用共享连接，而阻塞和事务操作仅通过 LettuceConnectionProvider 选择连接，这些连接不应共享。如果禁用了原生连接共享，则所有操作都将使用新（或池化）的连接。
